name: pterodactyl-mcp
description: MCP server for the Pterodactyl Panel Application and Client APIs (admin + live server control).
long_description: Manage Pterodactyl users, servers, nodes, locations, nests, eggs, and server databases (Application API), and control running servers with power signals, console commands, status, files, and backups (Client API). Includes 113 tools, 2 workflow prompts, and 2 resources covering both API trees.

panel_url.title: Panel URL
panel_url.description: Base URL of your Pterodactyl panel (no trailing slash).

panel_token.title: Application API Key
panel_token.description: Pterodactyl Application API key (usually starts with 'ptla_'). Backs the admin ptero_app_* / ptero_ai_* tools. Optional if a Client API key is provided.

panel_client_token.title: Client API Key
panel_client_token.description: Pterodactyl Client API key (usually starts with 'ptlc_'). Backs the ptero_client_* tools (power, console command, status, files, backups). Optional if an Application API key is provided. At least one key is required.
